status: cross-specimen anatomical eye-map hypothesis; not measured LC10a fields

method.registration: MaleCNS p=assignedOlHex2-19, q=assignedOlHex1-18; matched to centered FAFB p/q without fitting AOTU curves.
method.angle: Zhao et al. eye vector azimuth atan2(-y,x) in degrees; weighted upstream-column average per LC10a.
method.boundary: Unmatched MaleCNS boundary columns use 12-neighbor local affine eye-map interpolation/extrapolation.
method.fallback: Fewer than three upstream column edges: previous skeleton-estimated h, converted by median FAFB eye-map azimuth at each h.
method.excluded_information: No LC10a-to-AOTU edges, DNa02 edges, author pursuit curves, or behavioral scores used to assign angles.
